name: Naval Port of Karlskrona
description: Karlskrona is a baroque naval city spread across islands in the Blekinge archipelago on Sweden's southeast coast. Founded in 1680 as a base for the Swedish fleet, it was laid out on a deliberate plan, and much of that layout and many of its buildings survive. It is still home to Sweden's largest naval base, so historic docks and warships share the same harbour.
